params_note: dense; includes a pixtral vision tower + projector (~0.44 B); meta-device parameter count 13.945 B == safetensors total
dtype_note: bf16 (the -BF16 sibling repo; the main repo is FP8)
fits_single_80gb_detail: bf16 (the -BF16 repo): 27.9 GB; the FP8 main repo is ~15.7 GB but needs FP8 kernels (or dequantize=True)

hidden_last_80gb.verdict: fits: no hidden_last chunk of the hard / wmdp / nonbio direction pools exceeds the free memory of an 80 GB card (a prompt above max_tokens_per_chunk tokens would).
hidden_last_80gb.basis: ESTIMATE from config numbers, not a GPU measurement. sbx.core.Ctx.hidden_last / neutral_stats call model(**enc, output_hidden_states=True): per prompt token the hidden states of all layers ((num_layers+1) * hidden_size * 2 B), the full-sequence logits (vocab_size * 2 B) and, only if the model config has use_cache=true (forward(use_cache=None) then builds a cache; kv_cache_alive says so, and all OLMo configs ship use_cache=false), the KV cache (2 * layers * kv_heads * head_dim * 2 B; an upper bound for sliding-window layers) are alive at once, and bytes_per_prompt_token is their sum. core.batches() budgets KV, prefill attention and a 14000-token chunk but not this cost. free_gib_after_weights = 79.2 GiB (an 80 GB card) - 0.8 GiB (CUDA context) - bf16 weights. max_tokens_per_chunk = free / bytes_per_prompt_token: a chunk of b prompts padded to length p holds b*p tokens, and a single prompt above the limit cannot be processed at all. hard_pool_measured: core.batches(max_new=0, cap=16, free) over the direction-pool prompts evals.get_pool()['hard'] under framings N and E with this adapter and the real tokenizer; chunks_over_budget counts chunks whose estimated peak exceeds the free memory. Measured 2026-11-22; the pool follows sbx/evals.py (n_prompts and max_prompt_chars identify it).

access_check.method: HfApi.model_info + HTTP HEAD (huggingface_hub.get_hf_file_metadata) with the local HF token on config.json and the first safetensors shard (200 = accessible, 401/403 raise)

min_transformers_note: text model_type 'ministral3' is absent from the 4.57.0-4.57.6 wheels and present in 5.0.0 (checked); checkpoint config says 5.0.0.dev0
verified_transformers: 5.0.0 (config, meta build, tiny-model pipeline, tokenizer/template); 4.57.6 for tokenizer/template only
auto_class: AutoModelForImageTextToText (Mistral3ForConditionalGeneration with a ministral3 text model); needs transformers>=5.0

layer_path_verified.method: transformers 5.0.0 (read-only use of an existing scratch venv): AutoModelForImageTextToText.from_config(real hub config) on the torch meta device; plus a tiny random model of the same classes through sbx.core.Ctx. NOT buildable with the project's transformers 4.57.6.
layer_path_verified.convention: hidden_states[L] == output of layers[L-1] for 1 <= L < nl (exact on the tiny model); hidden_states[nl] is post final norm (avoid L = nl)

checkpoint_key_check.method: same check as the other cards but run with transformers 5.0.0 (read-only use of an existing scratch venv, torch meta device)
checkpoint_key_check.note: 585/585 keys match after _checkpoint_conversion_mapping; lm_head is not tied in the checkpoint (tie_word_embeddings=false)

est_prompt_tokens.basis: measured over data/questions_heldout_eval.jsonl (400 four-option bio questions) with the real tokenizer + adapter.build; long-context sets (labbench) are much longer

prompt_tokens_by_set.basis: framing N, real tokenizer + adapter.build over data/hard/*.jsonl, data/questions_heldout_eval.jsonl, data/wmdp_train.jsonl; n_over_context counts prompts with prompt_tokens + max_new > context_window

est_tokens_per_question_basis: estimate: brief visible CoT of a non-reasoning instruct model; NOT measured. Replace with the mean generated length from the first GPU run; outputs longer than max_new are truncated and count as unparsed.
template_notes: Tekken V7 string via the repo's own HF chat template (same format as Mistral Small). The template's default system prompt contains UNFILLED '{today}'/'{yesterday}' placeholders; the adapter fills them (pinned 2025-12-02/01), always renders an explicit system turn = default [+ blank line + framing]. The default prompt starts 'You are Ministral-3-14B-Instruct-2512, ...' (539 tokens). Last prompt token = [/INST]. Design choice: framing text is APPENDED to the model's default system prompt (default + blank line + framing), so N-vs-framing contrasts differ only by the framing paragraph; set the class attribute adapter.keep_default_system = False to get the vendor template's native semantics (framing REPLACES the default system prompt; N is unchanged).
known_issues: NOT LOADABLE with the project's transformers 4.57.6: text_config.model_type 'ministral3' exists only in transformers>=5.0 (verified: absent from 4.57.0-4.57.6 wheels, present in 5.0.0). Adapter.load() raises a clear RuntimeError on older versions. Layer path and the 1-based convention were verified with transformers 5.0.0 (meta-device config build + tiny random model through sbx.core.Ctx), prompt rendering with both 4.57.6 and 5.0.0; the real checkpoint was never loaded.

The adapter points at mistralai/Ministral-3-14B-Instruct-2512-BF16 (bf16 weights, identical chat template); the main repo is FP8 (compressed fine-grained fp8, static activation scheme) and would perturb activations.
In transformers 5 the tokenizer class is TokenizersBackend and fix_mistral_regex is no longer accepted; load_mistral_tokenizer handles both and verifies the tekken pre-tokenizer regex.
Repo holds consolidated.safetensors + HF shards (55.8 GB total); the HF shards are 27.9 GB.

Output format/length on the real model is UNVERIFIED (no GPU available when this card was written): max_new=512 for a 'brief' CoT is a guess; check the parse rate of baseline N on a few dozen questions and raise max_new (768/1024) if > ~3% of outputs are truncated without an 'Answer:' line.
est_tokens_per_question is an estimate from typical behaviour of the model family, not a measurement.
